evidenceEntries.title: Rosenberger OSI leader in the German data center market
evidenceEntries.snippet: Cabling market grew by 10 percent The study showed that the German structured cabling market grew by over 10 percent in 2022, both quantitatively and qualitatively. Although the market initially benefited from the lifting of remaining Covid-19 restrictions, growth was once again affected by geopolitical events such as the war in Ukraine. Manufacturers struggled with supply issues that impacted production and sales. The persistent inflationary pressure was further exacerbated by supply chain issues, leading to repeated price increases. Despite these challenges, the data center market continued to show solid growth and outperformed the LAN market, albeit with a lower margin than in previous years. Rosenberger OSI emerges as leader in the German data center market [...] Despite the intense competitive situation in the German market for structured cabling, as highlighted in the study with a large number of strong players, Rosenberger OSI has once again taken the top position as the leading company in the field of data centers and fiber optic connections. This result underlines the company's excellent position in the industry and its ability to provide innovative data center solutions.
